attribution: ViBench 2.0 is Replit's benchmark for long-horizon product building, now part of Fireworks' Specialized Intelligence Index. The main table is the official results from Fireworks runs, on the same harness and settings. Cost per build is USD at list prices. Pass@1 is the share of builds in which every test plan passes; plan pass rate is the share of a build's test plans that pass.
mapping_rule: A benchmark display name maps to a provider API model id only when the provider's own id for that product is the same product name in the provider's established id format and that exact id is attested (for Anthropic, the id claude-opus-5-5 already appears as this app's own Anthropic default, which attests the format). A mapping can only take effect when the provider's own models endpoint returns that exact id, so an unjustified mapping can never fire silently. Every other row is display-only: Auto never equates a benchmark name with an API model it cannot justify.

secondary_tables.description: A separate run by the ViBench team on the eight public products only (8 products x 4 builds), published separately from the official Fireworks results above. Display-only: none of these rows feed Auto ranking, and none carries a model id mapping.
secondary_tables.name: Scores across GPT generations
